text_block_list.text:
One day.
While walking through the academy...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is a kind offer, but...
are you truly certain about this?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I believe I can be of help
with my knowledge as the Expedition Support Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. Flash-san seemed to be
having some trouble, so I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "I heard her parents are coming all the way from Germany on her next day off."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And so, I was putting together a sightseeing itinerary.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My parents are always cheering me on, after all.
I want to welcome them with all my heart."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So I came up with a plan of my own
to make sure we could move efficiently, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. It is exceptionally well-constructed,
true to Flash-san's style. Truly efficient.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...However, you're worried about
whether this is truly the right path, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm usually good at scheduling,
but this is a whole different ballgame, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I make plans, I find myself wondering...
I wonder if my parents would be happy about it."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Flash-san, please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I will make sure to propose
the most optimal plan."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'd highly recommend this ranch.
It's a popular spot, and the distance from the academy is quite reasonable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I heard we can enjoy sweets made with
freshly squeezed milk at the attached cafe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, they're sure to be delighted.
After all, both of them are so eager to learn.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Assuming we depart from here at 16:00,
if we transfer to the rapid train three stations ahead...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Alright. It looks like we'll arrive at the academy's nearest station
with plenty of time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, it looks like we can visit one more place.
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we visit here as our final stop?
We can take in the full splendor of Japan's night view."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I think that sounds wonderful! I shall adopt your proposal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It's gotten quite late, hasn't it?
Thank you for staying with me this whole time..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
After all, I was the one who brought it up."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, helping ensure a smooth journey is
the Expedition Support Committee's job.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"If we do this, we do it thoroughly.
Half-hearted work brings shame to the committee's name, after all."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Journey-san...!

And so, the day-trip plan proposed by Dream Journey
was finalized. And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh my, a souvenir?
Thank you very much for your thoughtfulness.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "So, did your parents enjoy it?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so...! Journey-san,
thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Without your cooperation, I don't think
we could have spent such a fulfilling time."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for thanks.
I was simply being nosy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Above all else...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My parents are always cheering me on, after all.
I want to welcome them with all my heart."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Because I understand how you feel
all too well."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. I thought my knowledge from the Overseas Expedition Support Committee might come in handy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However, I would like to make more of a mark. To do that, I must raise my profile across the academy even further.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad to lend a small hand.
I'll recommend the committee to those around me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! Yes, please, I'd love to.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Not at all. Flash-san helped me brainstorm as well, after all."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I was the one who learned
a thing or two about schedule management.
I'd like to learn a bit more of your know-how.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'd call it expertise...
But if there's anything I can teach you, I'd be glad to do so as thanks.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you very much.
In that case, I look forward to your guidance.
